chunks: Are you astonished at this news,

key_terms.الْحَدِيثِ: the news, the report, or the revelation

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'Are you astonished at this news' in Surah An-Najm?
ai.summary: In this verse, Allah addresses the Quraysh's astonishment at the Quran, highlighting their spiritual insensitivity despite the clarity of the message. Shia exegetes often link this to the concept of *ta'wil* (interpretation), suggesting that their 'wonder' stems from a refusal to accept the divine authority of the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt. It serves as a rhetorical challenge to those who dismiss revelation as mere human speech rather than divine truth.
